title: Margin — Usage & Bugs
description: Bug reports first, then what people actually do: messages, calls, files, notifications. Source: margindb.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Total" FROM bug_reports
SELECT count(*) AS "New" FROM bug_reports WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT count(*) AS "Last 7 days" FROM bug_reports
WHERE created_at >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Reporters (range)
panels.description: Distinct users. One person filing ten reports is a different signal from ten people filing one each.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "Reporters" FROM bug_reports
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Reports per 100 active users
panels.description: Last 30 days of reports over monthly active users. Rising means quality is slipping faster than the user base is growing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * (
         SELECT count(*) FROM bug_reports
         WHERE created_at >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '30 days')
       / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM users
                 WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
                   AND last_seen_at >= now() - interval '30 days'), 0), 1)
       AS "Per 100 MAU"

panels.title: Reports with no timestamp
panels.description: bug_reports.created_at was added after the table existed and was never backfilled. These rows are invisible to every time-filtered panel here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "No timestamp" FROM bug_reports WHERE created_at IS NULL

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0), count(*) AS "Reports"
FROM bug_reports WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT u.display_name AS "Reporter",
       count(*) AS "Reports",
       max(b.created_at) AS "Last report"
FROM bug_reports b JOIN users u ON u.id = b.user_id
GROUP BY u.id, u.display_name
ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Latest bug reports
panels.description: Not time-filtered on purpose -- this is the triage queue. bug_reports has no status column, so nothing here can be marked resolved.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b.created_at AS "Reported",
       u.display_name AS "Reporter",
       b.title AS "Title",
       left(b.description, 400) AS "Description"
FROM bug_reports b JOIN users u ON u.id = b.user_id
ORDER BY b.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, b.id DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT count(*) AS "Messages" FROM messages
WHERE is_deleted = false AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT count(*) AS "Today" FROM messages
WHERE is_deleted = false AND created_at >= date_trunc('day', (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))

panels.title: Active senders (range)
panels.description: Users who actually sent something -- a stricter activity signal than last_seen_at.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT from_user_id) AS "Senders" FROM messages
WHERE is_deleted = false AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT round(CAST(count(*) AS numeric)
             / nullif(count(DISTINCT from_user_id), 0), 1)
       AS "Per sender"
FROM messages WHERE is_deleted = false AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT count(*) AS "Reactions" FROM message_reactions
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT count(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS "Conversations" FROM messages
WHERE is_deleted = false AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0), count(*) AS "Sent"
FROM messages WHERE is_deleted = false AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0), count(*) AS "Deleted"
FROM messages WHERE is_deleted = true AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.type AS "Type", count(*) AS "Messages"
FROM messages m JOIN conversations c ON c.conversation_id = m.conversation_id
WHERE m.is_deleted = false AND $__timeFilter(m.created_at)
GROUP BY c.type ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT emoji AS "Emoji", count(*) AS "Uses"
FROM message_reactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY emoji ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT count(*) AS "Calls" FROM calls WHERE $__timeFilter(offered_at)

SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE answered_at IS NOT NULL)
             / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS "Answer rate"
FROM calls WHERE $__timeFilter(offered_at)

SELECT round(CAST(avg(duration_seconds) AS numeric), 0) AS "Avg duration"
FROM calls
WHERE duration_seconds IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(offered_at)

panels.title: Total call minutes
panels.description: Drives SFU and TURN bandwidth cost.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(sum(duration_seconds) / 60.0, 0) AS "Minutes"
FROM calls WHERE $__timeFilter(offered_at)

panels.title: Failed calls
panels.description: status = FAILED. Distinct from REJECTED or NO_RESPONSE, which are people, not bugs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Failed" FROM calls
WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND $__timeFilter(offered_at)

SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE type = 'VIDEO')
             / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS "Video"
FROM calls WHERE $__timeFilter(offered_at)

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(offered_at, $__interval, 0),
       status AS metric,
       count(*) AS "Calls"
FROM calls WHERE $__timeFilter(offered_at)
GROUP BY 1, status ORDER BY 1

SELECT type AS "Type", count(*) AS "Calls"
FROM calls WHERE $__timeFilter(offered_at)
GROUP BY type ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(offered_at, $__interval, 0),
       round(sum(duration_seconds) / 60.0, 1) AS "Minutes"
FROM calls WHERE $__timeFilter(offered_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Storage used
panels.description: Live files only. This is what the S3 bill tracks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(size_bytes) AS "Storage" FROM stored_files WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT count(*) AS "Files" FROM stored_files WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT count(*) AS "Uploads" FROM stored_files WHERE $__timeFilter(uploaded_at)

panels.title: Avg file size
panels.description: Rows migrated from the old image_address column carry size_bytes = 0 and are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(CAST(avg(size_bytes) AS numeric), 0) AS "Avg size"
FROM stored_files WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND size_bytes > 0

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(uploaded_at, $__interval, 0), count(*) AS "Files"
FROM stored_files WHERE $__timeFilter(uploaded_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(uploaded_at, $__interval, 0),
       sum(size_bytes) AS "Bytes"
FROM stored_files WHERE $__timeFilter(uploaded_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Storage by workspace
panels.description: Only MARGIN- and CHANNEL-scoped files. Direct-conversation uploads have no margin_id and are not attributable to a workspace.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.name AS "Workspace",
       count(*) AS "Files",
       sum(f.size_bytes) AS "Bytes"
FROM stored_files f JOIN margins m ON m.margin_id = f.margin_id
WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY m.margin_id, m.name
ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Push tokens by platform
panels.description: Registered devices, a rough proxy for the mobile install base.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT platform AS "Platform", count(*) AS "Tokens"
FROM push_tokens GROUP BY platform ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0), count(*) AS "Created"
FROM notification WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0), count(*) AS "Still unseen"
FROM notification WHERE seen = false AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Applied migrations
panels.description: Which schema version production is actually running.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT version AS "Version",
       description AS "Migration",
       installed_on AS "Applied",
       success AS "OK"
FROM flyway_schema_history ORDER BY installed_rank DESC LIMIT 10
